nodes.description: AggregatorInterface public state variable holding the Chainlink aggregator address used by the adapter
uint256 public state variable storing the decimal scaling factor applied to the oracle answer
Public constructor that sets oracle and computes priceMultiplier from the supplied decimals
External view function that reads the aggregator answer, coerces it to uint256 and scales it
SafeMath library multiplication implementing the overflow-checked multiply used by read()
Constructor parameter of type AggregatorInterface assigned to the oracle state variable
Constructor parameter supplying the number of decimals used in the 10 ** decimals exponentiation
Local variable in read() holding the coerced uint256 value of the aggregator answer
Exponentiation 10 ** _priceMultiplierDecimals executed in the constructor without bound checks
External call oracle.latestAnswer() whose int256 result is coerced to uint256, an unchecked cast
Multiplication oracleOutput.mul(priceMultiplier) scaling the oracle value to 18 decimals

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _oracle is written directly into the oracle state variable, making the untrusted external aggregator address persistent state
_oracle is consumed as an input argument of the constructor function
_priceMultiplierDecimals is consumed as an input argument of the constructor function
The constructor stores the aggregator address in the oracle state variable
The exponent _priceMultiplierDecimals flows into the 10 ** decimals exponentiation, which can overflow or underflow the scaling factor
The exponentiation result is assigned to the priceMultiplier state variable, so any arithmetic error propagates to all future price reads
The constructor writes the computed multiplier into the priceMultiplier state variable
The oracle state variable supplies the contract address invoked by the external latestAnswer() call
The int256 answer returned by the external oracle is cast to uint256 and stored in the oracleOutput local variable, an unchecked narrowing/sign conversion
The oracleOutput local variable is the first operand of the price scaling multiplication
The priceMultiplier state variable is the second operand of the price scaling multiplication
The SafeMath.mul library function implements the overflow-checked multiplication used by the scaling operation
read() invokes the external oracle.latestAnswer() call whose result is coerced
read() declares and assigns the oracleOutput local variable
The scaled multiplication result is returned as the output of read()
read() performs an external call into the externally controlled oracle contract referenced by the oracle state variable, giving that untrusted address control flow back into the adapter

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _oracle is a non-core input that only exists to configure the constructor and is merged into the constructor function node
The constructor parameter _priceMultiplierDecimals is a non-core input consumed by the constructor and is merged into the constructor function node
The local variable oracleOutput is a non-core temporary whose only role is to feed the price scaling multiplication and is merged into that unsafe_operation node
